name: CDP Browser
author: amber
description: Controls a real Chrome browser through the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Use it when the task needs a live web page: navigate to URLs, read the page, evaluate JavaScript, click at coordinates, type text, take screenshots, and inspect the DOM. Requires Chrome running with --remote-debugging-port=9222; the endpoint is configurable via /plugin set cdp endpoint=ws://host:port.

cdp.help: Control a Chrome browser via CDP.
cdp.man: The cdp namespace drives a real Chrome browser through the DevTools Protocol (WebSocket to the endpoint in settings, default ws://127.0.0.1:9222). The plugin attaches to the first page target. Children: '/cdp list_targets' to enumerate open tabs, '/cdp navigate <url>' to go to a page, '/cdp eval <js>' to run JavaScript, '/cdp click <x> <y>' to click at page coordinates, '/cdp type <text>' to type into the focused element, '/cdp screenshot' to save a PNG into the workspace, '/cdp snapshot' for the page HTML, '/cdp url' for the current address.

list_targets.man: Queries the CDP HTTP endpoint /json and lists every target with its type, title, and URL.

navigate.help: Navigate the active tab to a URL.
navigate.man: Sends Page.navigate to the attached page target and reports the frame id.

eval.man: Runs an expression via Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue; returns the value (or 'undefined').

url.man: Evaluates location.href in the attached target.

click.man: Dispatches mousePressed/mouseReleased at (x, y) in CSS pixels via Input.dispatchMouseEvent.

type.help: Type text into the focused element.
type.man: Inserts text via Input.insertText into the currently focused element.

screenshot.help: Capture a PNG screenshot to the workspace.
screenshot.man: Uses Page.captureScreenshot (fromSurface, PNG) and writes the decoded image to .amber/cdp_<ts>.png; returns the path.

tools.name: list_targets
tools.description: List open browser tabs (type, title, url) from the CDP endpoint.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the active tab to a URL.

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page and return its value.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at (x, y) page coordinates with the left button.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the focused element.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Save a PNG screenshot of the page to the workspace and return its path.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Return the page HTML (truncated to 12 KiB).
